Tumburu
------------------------------------------
Tumburu was one of the sons of the sage कश्यप and Ariṣṭā. He belonged to the Gandharva group among the gods of हेअवेन्. He was a great musician attached to the court of इन्द्र, the king of gods.
Once he committed a heinous sin and was cursed by कुबेर to be born as a rākṣasa (demon). He was born as Virādha. Being killed by राम, he regained his original form (vide रामायण, Araṇya-kāṇḍa 4.16-18).
